subject: Frank v0.1 adaptive recurrence, v1.4 readout quality and self-hosted Ubuntu measurements

frank.message: Prioritize temporal multi-signal adaptive recurrence as a real-episode falsification candidate, not production selection. Sweep warmup/threshold operating windows; keep fixed-budget control and explicit false-halt/drift shadows.

harness.message: v1.4 re-entry factorial quality gate and adaptive differential are now in standard pytest/VPS integrity. Next replace synthetic trajectories with frozen runtime episodes and matched real local-4B runs.

gwt.message: Treat workspace/ignition signals as possible adaptive compute routing inputs, not truth. Compare temporal evidence against instantaneous thresholds and fixed budgets; preserve receiver-use/re-entry provenance.

emergenz.message: Adaptive recurrence, bounded cycles and lesion/rescue are useful causal controls but are not emergence or consciousness evidence. Reuse truthful/shuffled/no-reentry factorials without collapsing to one emergence scalar.

claycode.message: Future H2/H3 semantics need typed loop readout quality, recurrence decision reason, budget/warmup policy identity, operating-window receipt and rollback identity. No BASE gate credit from this H1 Python evidence.

hyperposition.message: Keep fixed, single-signal and temporal warmup variants as explicit competing policy states. Do not collapse to w4 until held-out/runtime/4B evidence discriminates them.

claygraph.message: Represent policy/configuration candidates, trajectory regimes, intervention edges, route/halt decisions and evidence receipts as derived epoch-bound relations; activation must not imply selection.

unifieddb.message: Persist loop samples, estimator identity/version/uncertainty/freshness, policy hash, decision receipt, downstream route outcome, cost and recovery so adaptive policy evaluation is exactly replayable.

clayresearch.message: External 2026 literature and local synthetic/VPS evidence converge on temporal adaptive compute as promising but threshold-sensitive. Favor Pareto operating regions and robustness gates over one scalar optimum.

next_falsifiers: downstream route benefit and route cost
